% Synthetic M8 fixture: the rendered tikzpicture subset. A shaded grid of
% \fill rectangles driven by nested \foreach (the unbraced-body form) with
% \pgfmathtruncatemacro arithmetic (max, *), labelled by \node with the
% \k/\lbl pair form, the label colour picked by ifthenelse over a
% comparison, under [scale=]. One construct outside the subset
% (\draw ... circle) is deliberate: it must be diagnosed by name (W0334)
% while every supported shape around it still draws. The boundary is open
% by default and would route the whole picture, so the subset witness
% declares the refusal. Invented content and design.
\documentclass{article}

\pictures{ tool = none }

\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro" }

\palette{
  grid = #2A6F4E,
  ink  = #14141A,
}

\begin{document}

\section{A shaded grid}

Before the diagram stands a paragraph, so the picture spaces below text.

\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.6]
  \foreach \x in {1,...,4}
    \foreach \y in {1,...,4} {
      \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\k}{max(\x,\y)}
      \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\shade}{20 + \k*18}
      \fill[grid!\shade] (\x-1,\y-1) rectangle ++(0.9,0.9);
    }
  \foreach \k/\lbl in {1/aa,2/bb,3/cc,4/dd} {
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\lblcol}{ifthenelse(\k<3,"ink","white")}
    \node[font=\small, text=\lblcol] at (\k-0.55,\k-0.55) {\lbl};
  }
  \draw (0,0) circle (1);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}

After the diagram stands another, so the flow resumes.

\end{document}
